title: MAVLink telemetry to TAK Cursor-on-Target
summary: Bridges autopilot GLOBAL_POSITION_INT messages into Cursor-on-Target events so a UAV shows up as a friendly track on ATAK, WinTAK or iTAK. A stdlib-only CoT builder with unit tests is paired with a pymavlink + PyTAK bridge that targets a TAK server or Mesh SA multicast.
verified: cot.py and 4 unit tests ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06. bridge.py ran end to end on 2026-11-06 with pymavlink 2.4.50 and pytak 7.6.1 (Python 3.12.14): fake_autopilot.py (pymavlink, UDP) => bridge.py => cot_sink.py received well-formed a-f-A-M-F-Q CoT at ~1 Hz over both tcp:// and udp+wo:// (unicast to localhost). Not verified: a real autopilot or SITL, multicast 239.2.3.1, TLS, a real TAK server or ATAK/WinTAK rendering.
